question: Summarize access paths to customer data in the payments estate.

hops.claim: Workflows on main in contoso/payments can sign in as payments-deploy.
User dev-lead is an owner of the payments-deploy app registration and can add credentials to it.
User helpdesk-07 holds Cloud Application Administrator, which can add credentials to payments-deploy.
Any credential on the payments-deploy app lets the holder sign in as its service principal.
The payments-deploy service principal holds Contributor on rg-payments-prod.
custdata and the Function App pay-reconcile are in rg-payments-prod.
Contributor can list custdata's keys, and shared key access is enabled, so the holder can read its blob data.
Contributor can deploy code to pay-reconcile, which runs as managed identity mi-pay-reconcile.
mi-pay-reconcile holds Storage Blob Data Reader on custarchive.

paths.target: Read archived customer data in custarchive
Read archived customer data in custarchive
Read archived customer data in custarchive

gaps.claim: Blob read logging is not enabled on custdata, so use of any path cannot be determined.
Blob read logging is not enabled on custarchive, so use of any path cannot be determined.

cutPoints.claim: Narrowing payments-deploy from Contributor to the specific roles its deployments need would close P1 through P3. P4 through P6 stay open while the pipeline deploys pay-reconcile, because deploying code lets the deployer act as that code.
